qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): M.Tech./ M.E. in Computer Science and Engineering/ Information Technology/ Electronics Engineering from a recognized University/ Institute with minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA (throughout from class X to the qualifying degree). For SC/ST/ Person with Disability (PwD) category, a minimum 55% marks or 6.0 CGPA (throughout from class X to the qualifying degree) is required. OR B.Tech./B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering / Information Technology / Electronics Engineering from a recognized University/Institute with minimum of 80% aggregate marks or 8.5 CGPA (throughout from class X to the qualifying degree) with valid GATE score are eligible to apply.

Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 18-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIEST Shibpur JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 18 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 33480. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Tech./M.E. in relevant fields with at least 60% marks or a B.Tech./B.E. with 80% marks and a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 28 years.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any age relaxations available?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/OBC/Woman and Physically handicapped candidates, up to 5 years.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email by sending their resume and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the JRF role at IIEST Shibpur?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Which department is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology Shibpur (IIEST Shibpur).
